proof_body:
by
  intro a
  rw [FormalMultilinearSeries.radius_inv_eq_limsup]
  have : ∀ n, ‖(FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a) n‖₊ = ‖a n‖₊ := fun n => by
    ext
    simp [FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_norm]
  simp_rw [this]
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℂ), ((FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars ℂ a).radius)⁻¹ = Filter.limsup (fun n : ℕ => (((‖a n‖₊ ^ (1 / (n : ℝ)) : NNReal)) : ENNReal)) Filter.atTop
